## Keahlian

- Backend: Go, Node.js, PHP, Laravel, Yii2, Python
- Frontend/Mobile: React.js, Flutter, JavaScript, Dart
- Database: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Firebase
- DevOps: Docker, Linux, Git, CI/CD
- Domain: Health Informatics (SIMRS/EMR), HRIS/absensi, integrasi SATUSEHAT & HL7 FHIR, autentikasi biometrik
